messages.author: 167f18bd6eb58693
messages.subject: Odds Ratio
parts:
I have been using Dudecer through JGR and I really like the
interface. How can I get Odds Rations (and associated confidence
intervals) after logistic regression?

Thanks!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Odds Ratio
parts:
There isn't a way to do that within the GUI. The odds ratios are just
the e^coefficients. You can get confidence intervals with the confint
function. So you can do something like the following:


> model.glm <- glm(formula=vs>0.0 ~ mpg + cyl + disp,family=binomial(),data=mtcars,na.action=na.omit)
> summary(model.glm)

messages.subject: Re: Odds Ratio
parts:
Thank you for your answer. I apologize, but I am not used to
calculating odds ratios like this: In your example above, does this
mean that the odds ration for mpg is 8.545398e-01 or e^8.545398e-01?

My sense is that it is e^8.545398e-01 (With confidence intervals
e^0.486388578 and e^1.415048e+00), but I want to be sure.

Thanks!

(The exp function does this), so the point estimate for mpg is .8545
with 95% confidence interval (.4864 1.4150).
